items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: All of them were together because they had a little band down there.

ctx.x: Oh, I beg your pardon. He wasn't quite full as son Henry was from Magnolia. Yeah. He was between Magnolia and this other big farm he had he got down there. I just remember.
Jim says he came from Deer Range I think. Yeah.
Yeah. That's where him and Chris all them came from the same place. Down the same locality.
